profileText: a Representative from North Carolina; born in San Diego County, Calif., June 21, 1987; graduated from Francis Parker High School, San Diego Calif., 2005; B.S., West Point Military Academy, West Point, N.Y., 2009; United States Army, 2009-2014, Afghanistan War Veteran; business owner; unsuccessful candidate for election to the One Hundred Eighteenth Congress in 2022; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 3, 2025-present).
